description: Urban wastewater generated by method of handling and discharge without treatment (million m3) is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. This dataset presents the total amount of wastewater collected annually in Qatar, measured in million cubic meters. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are wastewater collection, total wastewater, Qatar, environment. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-04-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
